'''Bansche Tech''', also known as '''Banche Tech''', was a major [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporation]] with diverse holdings headquartered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chamble/Legends|Chamble]]. They were also know to produce matrixes and mission specific components for the [[Black market/Legends|underground]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] market. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Bansche Tech was nationalized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Alongside [[Sencil Corporation]], [[Reiber Manufacturing]], and [[SGI Systems, Inc.]], Bansche Tech was reformed into the [[Imperial Droid Corporation]].<ref name="GNN6" />
